scope: Three original bilingual public scenes for the bounded five/ten-minute listening and speaking route, with separate changed-detail retelling and fresh later-day transfer tasks.

exports.loading: The data module imports/re-exports model types only. The practice view may import the complete scenes lazily; parsing/scoring uses the separate small identity table.

sceneReview.publicSituationReused: A small purchase at a stall; this extends the existing original market situation rather than copying its bread/water dictation.

gist.answerWitness: The initial apple request is unavailable; the buyer explicitly accepts pears.
gist.distractors: Buying nothing and reserving apples for tomorrow do not occur.

detail.answerWitness: The final purchase is one kilo; the two-kilo quantity belongs to the earlier request.

sceneReview.retellChanges: Tomatoes unavailable; accept two kilos of courgettes at three euros per kilo; six-euro total.
sceneReview.laterTransferChanges: A bakery replaces the fruit stall; four requested bread rolls become three available rolls at one euro each; include a polite closing.
sceneReview.modelRubricCheck: Both production models state the requested and accepted quantities consistently. The arithmetic is six euros for the retell and three euros for transfer.

sceneReview.publicSituationReused: An invitation to a shared activity; the new scene negotiates a changed day and distinguishes destination from meeting point.

gist.answerWitness: Saturday work prevents the original plan; Sunday is proposed and accepted.
gist.distractors: The activity is not cancelled and the Saturday arrangement is not retained.

detail.answerWitness: The speakers meet in front of the library; the park is the eventual destination.

sceneReview.retellChanges: An invented friend works Tuesday evening; cinema moves to Wednesday at half past seven, meeting in front of the post office.
sceneReview.laterTransferChanges: An invented neighbour is invited for Friday coffee at three; accept Saturday at four, meeting in front of the statue.
sceneReview.modelRubricCheck: The immediate and later models preserve their distinct day changes, final times and meeting points. Present-tense arrangements and familiar invitation chunks keep the task bounded.

sceneReview.publicSituationReused: An interrupted journey/change of plan; this new account concerns a tram-stop closure and a bus journey to a museum.

gist.answerWitness: The speaker waits for a tram, the stop closes, and she takes a bus to reach the museum.
gist.distractors: She does not abandon the visit or wait at the stop until evening.

detail.answerWitness: The final line states arrival at eleven.

sceneReview.retellChanges: Nora waits for a train; cancellation is announced; she takes a bus to the cinema and arrives at six.
sceneReview.laterTransferChanges: Leo cycles to the sports centre; a chain breaks; he continues on foot, arrives at half past seven and describes his feeling.
sceneReview.modelRubricCheck: Background and completed events remain distinct. Feminine Nora/arrivata and masculine Leo/arrivato are consistent. The later model changes person, problem, transport, destination and time.

answerContract.scoring: One authored option is supported for each bounded question. Option IDs and the model identity/scoring table match exactly. Incorrect alternatives do not describe events stated in the scene.
answerContract.beforeListening: Titles and contexts identify the task without naming the final choice, changed day, transport solution or requested detail.
answerContract.afterGist: Each gist explanation confirms the overall decision while withholding the quantity, meeting point or arrival time required by its detail question.
answerContract.production: Frames and possible models support practice. Both immediate retells and later transfers use explicit self-checks, not automatic semantic, grammar or pronunciation grading. Rubrics may name required details, including the market total; they are not evidence of unaided productive accuracy.
answerContract.laterDay: The later task retrieves and adapts a communicative pattern with new supplied details. It is not a second copy of the original scene or a validated measure of retention.

provenanceAndPrivacy.authorship: All dialogue, choice labels, explanations, prompts, frames and possible models are original portal companion content written for this route.
provenanceAndPrivacy.existingSituationReference: app/learning/listening.tsx original market/meeting/delay situations were read for continuity. Their existing IDs and passages were not edited by this content task.
provenanceAndPrivacy.privateSources: No private book text, worksheet answers, source recordings, personal details or new book-page citations were added.
provenanceAndPrivacy.assessmentLimit: A1/A2 are content bands for these bounded practice topics. The scenes and self-checks do not establish a CEFR level or independently assessed spontaneous speech.
provenanceAndPrivacy.researchLimit: The route structure is part of the parent learning-design work. This content review records authored-task checks, not a new efficacy study or real-user learning outcome.

validation.inlineStructuralCheck: Passed: three unique scenes, twelve bilingual lines, six bounded questions, eighteen options, identity parity, six distinct production tasks and twelve rubric criteria.
validation.modelAgentChecks: The model agent reported twelve oral-model tests and eleven backup tests passed, including full-content-to-light-identity parity; targeted TypeScript including this data module passed.
validation.independentLanguageReview: A separate agent read all three scenes, choices, explanations, retell/transfer prompts, frames, models and rubrics. No blocking Italian/English, answer-witness, gist leakage or changed-detail inconsistency was found.
validation.focusedLint: Passed, together with the focused diff check.
validation.browser: Parent UI integration and isolated browser testing remain separate from this content-only review.
